name: Maintenance presents all four tools in one administrator area

Investigator retains every source row for a summarized journal line
Correction preview uses the final staged amounts without mutating its source
Investigator follows entry lines and account links without unrelated entries
Month closing requires actual amounts, each acknowledgment, a reason and coverage
Unbalanced trial blocks closing and cannot be overridden

Cash variance acknowledgment does not unlock unresolved open items
Export contains complete raw source tables and keyed comparison data
